files_reviewed: src/** other pages and components (grep only: VITE_, import.meta.env, localStorage, setTimeout, console.log, TODO, fetch, toast, useMutation, openai)
note: .env.example not read (permission rule). Not reviewed: convex/_generated, demo/remotion/src, docs and markdown, images. Strong points: no model call runs in the browser and no VITE_ secret exists (push-env.mjs skips VITE_ keys). The AgentMail webhook checks its Svix signature. Every public Convex function derives identity on the server and checks ownership with requireOwned or getRenter. No .env is committed. UI success toasts all follow awaited mutations. Autopilot is off by default, guests may only email the demo landlord, and email, scrape, draft and lease calls have per-renter and global rate limits. No ai_tool_unbounded label: every email, scrape and lease tool has a cap.

labels.what: With autopilot on, saveDraft queues a model-written email to a real landlord with no approval step. applyAnalysis (threads.ts 815-816) starts the next draft by itself after each landlord reply, so a whole negotiation can run unseen. Opt-in, off by default, capped at 8 emails per thread and the daily email limits

Rule to state only facts from RENTER FACTS, LISTING FACTS or renter notes. policyViolations only checks commitment phrases and budget figures, so an invented fact passes, and with autopilot it is sent with no review
Rule to never invent competing offers, other applicants, deadlines, urgency or market statistics. No code check exists. The Settings page (AutopilotCard.tsx line 14) promises users it never happens
The budget part of this rule is checked (budget figure next to a limit word). The clause 'never say or imply the renter is considering other homes' has no check
Rule to never accept a rent, fee or term for the renter. The COMMITMENT regex catches sign, pay, wire, deposit and SSN wording, but not acceptance wording such as 'we accept the $1,900 offer'
Rule to ask for at most two concessions, only from ALLOWED ASKS. chooseAsks limits what the prompt offers, but enforcePolicy never counts or checks the asks in the model output
Rule to answer a landlord question only from RENTER FACTS or renter notes. No code check that answers come from those facts
Rule to stay under 170 words. Code only adds a 'runs long' note to the rationale past 210 words and still sends the draft

Prompt requires each clauseQuote to be copied word for word from the lease. quoteAppearsIn checks this only for the bundled sample (137-141). Uploaded leases save model flags with no quote check (leaseSchema.ts comment admits the PDF text never reaches the code)

Demo landlord prompt says to add no other times, prices, offers, conditions or questions. faithful() only checks dollar figures and the tour times, so an added offer, condition or question passes. Demo only

UI promises autopilot stops 'after 10 emails to real landlords in a day'. Code caps sendExternalEmail at 6 a day per renter (limits.ts 24) and globalExternalEmail at 15 a day (limits.ts 26). Same limit, two different numbers
All scrape, email, draft, lease and upload quotas are hardcoded in code. Two more limiters are defined in other files (renters.ts 23-25, leaseAudits.ts 27-30)
Model ids and fallback models hardcoded, not set by env
Demo capture script hardcodes the production deployment host and a localhost dev URL
Narration script reads an env file from an absolute path in the author's home folder
Fixed password for dev test accounts committed in the demo capture script: secret value present. Dev target only, prod reads a gitignored creds file

Password accounts need no email verification. Not being a guest is the only gate before Nestor emails real landlords, and the renter can type any address as the landlord email (listings.ts 345-373). Anyone can create an account and send AI-written mail from Nestor's inbox to any address, within the daily caps

The demo landlord calls OpenAI on every simulated reply with no rate limit. Guests are one click to create, so there is no shared ceiling on this spend. In replyToEmail the globalSimEmail check runs after compose has already paid for the call

Inbound mail to the agent inbox is matched to a thread by AgentMail thread id or In-Reply-To/References, and the sender is never compared with thread.landlordEmail. Any third party on the thread can inject a landlord reply that sets offers, tour times and, with autopilot, an automatic answer
When the AgentMail account is full, this CLI tool borrows any inbox that is not Nestor's, against the promise in mail.ts 93-94 that no other inbox is touched. Internal action only

Demo landlord replies are scripted: beat 1 always grants one concession and offers two tour times, then repeats it. The model only rewords the script. Labelled as a demo in the feed and used for guests, sample listings and deployments with no AgentMail key
Sample lease check returns the pre-written CANNED_SAMPLE_AUDIT as a done review when OpenAI is off, the sample quota is spent, or the model call fails. The summary says it is pre-written
Without a Firecrawl key, 'discover' loads the bundled sample listings in place of a web search. Labelled demo mode in the feed

Demo-thread emails are marked sent with no email when inbound mail is not live. A failed AgentMail send on a demo thread is also marked sent (272-275), and a timed-out one too (358-364). The feed says the message stayed inside Nestor
Six invented listings with landlord personas, built around the renter's own city and budget. Stored with isSample true and labelled as samples
Fictional sample lease text (12-73) and a pre-written canned review with flags (80-196)
Seed renter 'Jordan Avery' with a fixed passport token. Internal CLI mutation only
ensureDemoListing inserts a hardcoded Maple Court listing with a fixed 88 match score. Internal CLI mutation only
Landing page plays a fictional renter, landlord, $50 rent cut and booked tour as a live activity feed. File comment says captions mark it as fiction
